main.description: Competitive funding: a grant, fellowship, or contract. Both awarded and unsuccessful applications can be represented, but note that writing an unsuccessful application to a public PDS discloses it -- if you do not want it known, do not create the record.

funder.description: Funding body. ROR strongly preferred: funder name strings are notoriously inconsistent across a career.

programName.description: e.g. '科学研究費助成事業 基盤研究(C)', 'ERC Starting Grant'.

awardNumber.description: Grant number, e.g. '23K12345'. The de facto identifier and what acknowledgements sections cite.

role.description: 'hostResearcher' is 受入研究者, a formally recognised role on Japanese fellowships with no Anglophone equivalent.

totalAmount.description: Total award to the whole project.

shareAmount.description: The portion allocated to this person. Distinguishing the two is required by most tenure and promotion files.

amountDisclosure.description: ADVISORY ONLY. Set to 'withheld' AND omit the amount fields if the figure should not be shown -- a value present in the record is public regardless of this flag.

outputs.description: StrongRefs to pub.paper.reference records produced under this grant. Makes reporting obligations answerable from the record set.

url.description: Public award page, e.g. a KAKEN project URL.

fundingType.description: Funding instrument. researchmap files 共同研究 and 競争的資金 in one section but they are different animals: 'contractResearch' (企業からの受託研究) and 'jointResearch' (共同研究) are commissioned work, not competitive awards, and evaluation committees weigh them differently. 'donation' is 寄附金.

partnerOrganizations.description: Participating institutions and companies. Separate from `collaborators`, which is people: a contract research project lists 株式会社クラレ and 国立国際医療研究センター as parties, and forcing an organisation into a personRef loses its ROR.
